qt: to the Commission Galato Alexandraki (ECR) Subject:

The provisional agreement between the European Parliament and the Council of 20 October 2026 provides for an extension of the recognition of the equivalence of organic production rules of 11 non-EU countries until 2036. It also sets out additional requirements for the use of the EU organic logo on imported products. Greek organic farmers are burdened with significant certification and compliance costs. This extension must be accompanied by effective checks to ensure a level playing field and to prevent consumers from being misled. In view of the above, can the Commission say: 1.
What specific programme of checks does it intend to implement in the 11 non-EU countries and their certification bodies during the extension period?
How will the compliance of imported products with the additional requirements for the use of the EU organic logo be checked?
Does it intend to publish annually the results of the checks and any infringements – broken down by country and product category – as well as the corrective measures taken?
